description: Farm PAPER on Papertrade: hold a long and a short, close both on a set price move, repeat until a loss budget is spent.

PAPERTRADE_HELPER.description: The helper path that `papertrade.py duty-helper` returns, as written.

MARKET.description: The market both legs open on.

MARGIN_USD.description: USD of margin per leg; a cycle holds twice this.

MOVE_PCT.description: Price move in percent, either way from the legs' average entry, that closes both legs.

BUDGET_USD.description: USD the closed cycles may lose in all before the farm stops.

STOP.description: true stops the farm: it closes every leg it opened, then ends. Set it with a settings update; never pause the duty, which leaves its legs open.
